props.title: AI trading in one breath
items: AI trading = the Data → Model → Signal → Risk → Order pipeline, automated
AI only lives in the model box — it finds patterns, it can't predict
Institutions win on speed and scale; your only hope is a smarter, slower niche
Most bots die of overfitting, costs, and latency — the backtest is a hypothesis
Start no-code, keep money in your own broker, and follow SEBI's rules
Build in code box-by-box; add AI last; walk-forward is your honesty test
The edge is a process you build, not a product you buy
props.closer: Trade the process, not the hype. Thanks for watching.

props.title: One important disclaimer

items.h: This is education, not investment advice
items.sub: Nothing here is a buy, sell, or hold recommendation for anyone.

items.h: Markets carry real risk of real loss
items.sub: You can lose money, quickly. Never risk what you can't afford to lose.

items.h: Verify every rule and figure yourself
items.sub: Regulations and costs change — confirm on official SEBI and exchange sites.

items.h: For personal advice, see a SEBI-registered advisor
items.sub: A licensed professional can look at your specific situation.

props.caption: Learn deeply, act carefully, and let the process protect you.
